cohort: The study included 230 women aged 20-40 years at term (37-40 gestational weeks) with abnormal intrapartum cardiotocography trace in labor and cephalic presentation, excluding those with congenital abnormalities, malpresentation, multiple gestations, or pre-existing medical disorders.
finding: In cases with abnormal intrapartum CTG, 36.9% of neonates had an Apgar score <7 at 5 minutes, 31.3% were admitted to the nursery, and perinatal mortality was 16.5%.
